evals.prompt: SIMULATION ONLY: do not inspect a repository, call a database, or mutate files. The current branch changes a products table and its categories FK; a reviewed data plan already identifies three existing products, two category parents, and rows across happy, edge, error, and stupid buckets. Describe the exact default /check-data action trace from discovery through the report.
evals.expected_output: Discovers branch, ticket, diff, schema, database, and seed options; writes a schema-aware four-bucket plan; continues from the written plan in the same invocation with FK-ordered, idempotent insertion; performs before/after verification with inserted/skipped/failed accounting; and reports safe evidence without raw credentials.
expectations: discovers the branch, ticket context, diff, schema, database access, and existing project seed mechanism
writes a schema-aware plan covering happy, edge, error, and stupid rows
continues from the written plan into FK-ordered idempotent insertion without delegating to another skill
uses natural-key matching or a branch seed tag and continues after individual row failures
reports before, inserted, skipped, failed, and after counts and never exposes raw credentials

evals.prompt: SIMULATION ONLY: do not inspect a repository, call a database, or mutate files. The user invokes /check-data plan-only for a branch whose diff touches orders and users. Describe the exact action trace and terminal report behavior.
evals.expected_output: Discovers enough context to write a schema-aware four-bucket plan and stops after writing the plan; plan-only performs no database mutation and reports that seeding and verification were intentionally skipped.
expectations: accepts plan-only as an optional argument
writes the same schema-aware happy, edge, error, and stupid planning output
branches immediately after writing the plan and stops before any database mutation
does not run insertion, count verification, or another skill
keeps credentials out of the report and states the plan-only limitation
